summary: Genmab A/S, a Danish foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a company announcement that its Extraordinary General Meeting on October 7, 2026 approved the Board's proposed 2026 director remuneration, including share-based awards. A total of 5,300 restricted stock units were granted cost-free to board members, each carrying a conditional right to one DKK 1 nominal share, at a fair value of DKK 2,487.00 per unit, vesting on the first banking day following three years from grant. This is a routine equity-compensation governance matter, not a special situation; no deal, stake, or strategic event is involved.
